title: Lady Gaga’s former NYC penthouse, also home to Carmelo Anthony, Tracy Morgan, listed for $7 million
summary_full: Lady Gaga’s former New York City penthouse has hit the market for $6.995 million. The 3,700-square-foot luxury duplex, which was also once home to Carmelo Anthony and Tracy Morgan, features three bedrooms, a chef’s kitchen and a sprawling terrace offering stunning city views. The property is located in the iconic Hit Factory Condominium.
